_doc: Rift field extras (docs/KAMPF_PLAN_1000.md, Rift-Felder und Umgebung), read by scripts/battle/RiftFields.gd. The rules of each field stay in BattleRules.FIELDS; this file holds how a field looks and sounds and where it turns up. tint: colour laid over the backdrop per field; tint_alpha per era (Era I is a 4-ink handheld, so every field gets the same dark ink there, only stronger or weaker). music_pitch: the battle song plays a touch lower or higher while the field lasts. daytime: a Resonance field laid at its own time of day (DayCycle phase names) holds extra turns. tower: share of lighthouse stair floors (from from_floor on) that stand in a random field. spawn: wild Spirlings of the boosted element come out more often on a map with that field. rift_maps: the field the wild battles of a Rift map without its own "field" stand in (a Warden keeps the place as it is), so the Rifts vary their fields, the later elements' fields among them (KAMPF_PLAN_1000 item 94).
